question_text: A flute player produces a flute in a location where the speed of sound in air is 330 $m s^{-1}$ when the note A is played, it occurs exactly at 440 Hz. If the tuning fork of this flute is sounded simultaneously with the same note A produced by another flute at a location where the speed of sound is 333 $m s^{-1}$, what will be the beat frequency heard?
